_comment: Which SHAPE each structure family trades. One champion per family; the others are superseded, not disabled — they stay in engine.structures.STRUCTURES so old experiments replay and so a promotion can be rolled back. See engine/structure_registry.py. The twin-peak family (TWIN-P vs TWIN-P5, champion TWIN-P5 2026-09-04 on EXP-126) was retired 2026-09-06: a further comparison found the two are not mutually exclusive — they win on different events — so both are live now instead of one being superseded. See engine/entry_rules.py TWIN_P_LEGACY_RULE for the retired champion record.
